rules.name: Modifying a Stratagem's CP Cost
rules.effect: If a rule lets you target a friendly unit with a Stratagem for 0CP but does not specify that Stratagem by name, reduce the CP cost of that use by 1CP instead.

rules.name: Stratagems That Can Be Used More Than Once Per Phase/Turn
rules.effect: Permission to use a Stratagem again in the same phase only works when the enabling rule specifies the Stratagem by name. The same named-Stratagem requirement applies when overriding a once-per-player-per-turn, once-per-battle-round or once-per-battle limit.

rules.name: Stratagems That Prevent Units From Being Targeted
rules.effect: A Stratagem effect that previously required an attacking model to be within 12 inches to target the unit with ranged attacks instead uses 18 inches.

rules.name: Stratagems That Add New Units To Your Army
rules.effect: If a Stratagem adds a new unit identical to a destroyed unit, that Stratagem gains a restriction that it can only be used once per battle.
